description:
Get what to draw inside a drawn shape: a polygon, or a line with a buffer.

    The same answer as map_viewport for the shape's bounding box, limited to what
    is inside the shape, at the same detail levels (clusters, pins, or named pins
    at zoom 15+). The response adds `shape: 'polygon' | 'route'`.

    Returns: { shape, mode, zoom, bbox, datasetVersion, total, breakdown {street,
    housed, homeless, incarcerated}, clusters[], markers[], areas[], unplaced
    {count, states}, notice }.
      - A marker with `id: null` and a `groupId` stands for several people at one
        address: call map_group with that `groupId`.
      - `areas` are people placed only at the middle of a ZIP, city or county.
        Never describe them as being at an exact spot.
      - To see who one marker is, call map_open_record with its `id`.

    A pin shows a REGISTERED ADDRESS, not a person's current location — say so
    when you describe a result (`notice` carries the sentence).

    Billing: one map request per call ($2 per 1,000), whatever the shape holds.
    Marker and group ids work for 24 hours. The Map API must be turned on for the
    account (403 `map_not_enabled` otherwise); `sandbox=true` works without it.

    Auth: uses the caller's X-API-Key (request header or OFFENDERSEARCH_API_KEY env).

buffer_miles.description: Distance either side of route_points, in miles, 0.05 to 5.
buffer_miles.title: Buffer Miles

detail.description: full = clusters or pins (default); count = numbers only.
detail.title: Detail

housing.description: Keep only people with one of these housing statuses.
housing.title: Housing

polygon.description: A ring of 3 to 200 [lng, lat] points (GeoJSON order: longitude first), e.g. [[-83.0,39.9],[-82.9,39.9],[-82.95,40.0]]. A repeated closing point is fine. Send this OR route_points, not both.
polygon.title: Polygon

route_points.description: A line of 2 to 200 [lng, lat] points (GeoJSON order). Everyone within buffer_miles either side of it is counted. Send with buffer_miles, instead of polygon. For exact per-leg and per-stop counts along a walking or bus route use map_route.
route_points.title: Route Points

sandbox.description: If true, answer in test mode: made-up people (labels start with 'Sample') in the real response shape. Needs no plan and is never billed.
sandbox.title: Sandbox

street_only.description: If true, keep only people with an exact street address.
street_only.title: Street Only

zoom.description: Optional map zoom, 0 to 22. Decides the detail as on map_viewport: 3-12 clusters, 13-14 pins without names, 15+ pins with names. Omit it and the zoom is worked out from the size of the shape.
zoom.title: Zoom

name: map_area
